props.name: allowThumbCrossing
props.description:
Whether dragging can continue across another thumb when there is no minimum gap. When `false`,
a thumb stops at its neighbor. Ignored while `minStepsBetweenThumbs` is above `0`.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content rendered inside the root after the thumbs, or a render function receiving the live slider state.
A render function must declare its parameter, even when unused. A zero-argument
function is called as an accessor and is not mounted as a component.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value (uncontrolled), with the same number or array shape as `value`; its shape
also sets the shape that `onValueChange` and `onValueCommit` receive. Defaults to `min`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: form
props.description:
The id of a `<form>` the hidden inputs belong to, instead of the closest
ancestor form.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description:
`Intl.NumberFormat` options used to format each thumb's raw value (not its share of the
`min`-`max` range) for `aria-valuetext`, using the provider locale. Formatting does not change
the value passed to callbacks. A `percent` style multiplies by 100, so pair it with a `0`-`1`
range.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Receives the hidden `<input type="range">` of the first thumb.

props.name: markers
props.description:
Visual markers on the track. `true` marks every `step` and needs a `step` greater than 0.
A number marks every that many units without affecting snapping.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value of the slider.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value of the slider.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description:
Minimum distance between neighboring thumbs in a multi-thumb slider, counted in `step` units
(1% of the range when `step` is not set). A value above `0` also stops thumbs from crossing,
regardless of `allowThumbCrossing`.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called on every value change during interaction (pointer drag, track click, or key press),
with the new value in the same shape as `value`. Does not fire for programmatic changes to
`value`. Use `onValueCommit` to react once per finished interaction.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description:
Called once an interaction that changed the value finishes: when the pointer is released,
when a navigation key is released, or when focus leaves the slider. Receives the final value in
the same shape as `value`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the track. A `vertical` slider fills the height of its parent and puts `min` at the bottom unless `reversed`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: reversed
props.description:
Reverses the track direction, so `min` sits at the right (or top when vertical) instead of
the left (or bottom) in left-to-right layouts.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: step
props.description:
Step increment between values; pointer and keyboard values snap to multiples of it from `min`.
When omitted (or not above `0`), pointer movement is continuous and arrow keys move by 1% of
the range. `PageUp`/`PageDown` and `Shift` + arrow move by about 10% of the range.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description:
Visual alignment of the thumb at the track ends.
`'overflow'` centers the thumb on the value so half of it extends past
the track at `min` and `max`. `'contain'` clamps the thumb inside the
track so its edges stay within bounds. Value mapping is unaffected.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Localized message overrides for this slider instance: `thumb` returns each thumb's
`aria-label` and `valueText` returns its `aria-valuetext`.

props.name: value
props.description:
The current value (controlled). A number renders one thumb and an array renders one thumb per
entry (an empty array gives one thumb at `min`). Values are clamped to `min`-`max` and
arrays are sorted. Leave it `undefined` for uncontrolled usage. The slider throws a
`RangeError` when `max` is not greater than `min`.
